# INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS and TABLE_OPTIONS values documented by BigQuery.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/information-schema-datasets-schemata-options
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/information-schema-table-options

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_options_expiration;
ALTER SCHEMA scalars_options_expiration SET OPTIONS (default_table_expiration_days = 90);
SELECT CONCAT(option_type, ' ', option_value) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS WHERE schema_name = 'scalars_options_expiration' AND option_name = 'default_table_expiration_days'
=> "FLOAT64 90.0"

# 0.08333333333333333 is the floating point representation of 2 hours.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_options_hours;
ALTER SCHEMA scalars_options_hours SET OPTIONS (default_table_expiration_days = 0.08333333333333333);
SELECT option_value FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS WHERE schema_name = 'scalars_options_hours' AND option_name = 'default_table_expiration_days'
=> "0.08333333333333333"

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_options_labels;
ALTER SCHEMA scalars_options_labels SET OPTIONS (labels = [('org', 'dev')]);
SELECT FORMAT('%t %s %s', catalog_name = @@project_id, option_type, option_value) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS WHERE schema_name = 'scalars_options_labels' AND option_name = 'labels'
=> "true ARRAY<STRUCT<STRING, STRING>> [STRUCT(\"org\", \"dev\")]"

# Datasets without labels are excluded.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_options_unlabeled;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS WHERE schema_name = 'scalars_options_unlabeled' AND option_name = 'labels'
=> "0"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.options_expiring (x INT64) OPTIONS (expiration_timestamp = TIMESTAMP '2099-01-16 21:12:28 UTC');
SELECT CONCAT(option_type, ' ', option_value) FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS WHERE table_name = 'options_expiring' AND option_name = 'expiration_timestamp'
=> "TIMESTAMP TIMESTAMP \"2099-01-16T21:12:28.000Z\""

# Tables without an expiration time are excluded.
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.options_lasting (x INT64);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS WHERE table_name = 'options_lasting' AND option_name = 'expiration_timestamp'
=> "0"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.options_described (x INT64) OPTIONS (description = 'test data');
SELECT FORMAT('%t %s %s %s', table_catalog = @@project_id, table_schema, option_type, option_value) FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS WHERE table_name = 'options_described' AND option_name = 'description' AND option_value LIKE '%test%'
=> "true scalars STRING \"test data\""

# TABLE_OPTIONS also describes views.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.options_view OPTIONS (description = 'test data') AS SELECT 1 AS x;
SELECT option_value FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS WHERE table_schema = 'scalars' AND table_name = 'options_view' AND option_name = 'description'
=> "\"test data\""

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.options_labeled (x INT64) OPTIONS (labels = [('org', 'dev')]);
SELECT CONCAT(option_type, ' ', option_value) FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS WHERE table_name = 'options_labeled' AND option_name = 'labels'
=> "ARRAY<STRUCT<STRING, STRING>> [STRUCT(\"org\", \"dev\")]"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.options_named (x INT64) OPTIONS (friendly_name = 'test data');
SELECT CONCAT(option_type, ' ', option_value) FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS WHERE table_name = 'options_named' AND option_name = 'friendly_name'
=> "STRING \"test data\""

# BigQuery's answers to cases its documentation leaves open.

# A dataset that sets no options lists its location, and a table none.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_options_plain;
SELECT STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%s %s %s', option_name, option_type, option_value), '; ' ORDER BY option_name) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS WHERE schema_name = 'scalars_options_plain'
=> "location STRING \"us\""

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_options_eu OPTIONS (location = 'EU');
SELECT option_value FROM `region-eu`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS WHERE schema_name = 'scalars_options_eu' AND option_name = 'location'
=> "\"eu\""

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.options_plain (x INT64);
SELECT STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%s %s %s', option_name, option_type, option_value), '; ' ORDER BY option_name) FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS WHERE table_name = 'options_plain'
=> null

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_options_rounding OPTIONS (default_rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN');
SELECT FORMAT('%s %s', option_type, option_value) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS WHERE schema_name = 'scalars_options_rounding' AND option_name = 'default_rounding_mode'
=> "STRING \"ROUND_HALF_EVEN\""

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.options_rounding (x NUMERIC) OPTIONS (default_rounding_mode = 'ROUND_HALF_EVEN');
SELECT FORMAT('%s %s', option_type, option_value) FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS WHERE table_name = 'options_rounding' AND option_name = 'default_rounding_mode'
=> "STRING \"ROUND_HALF_EVEN\""

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.options_quoted (x INT64) OPTIONS (description = 'a "b" \'c\' \\ \n d');
SELECT option_value FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS WHERE table_name = 'options_quoted' AND option_name = 'description'
=> "\"a \\\"b\\\" 'c' \\\\ \\n d\""

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_options_days OPTIONS (default_table_expiration_days = 3.75);
SELECT option_value FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS WHERE schema_name = 'scalars_options_days' AND option_name = 'default_table_expiration_days'
=> "3.75"
